questions.question: Dr. Mourad, now a national reference in ethics, is invited to an international congress. What message should he carry?
options: Ethics is an art in the service of the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethics is an art in the service of the patient, combining values and humanity.' Dr. Manal: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must create a foundation to promote dental ethics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Promoting ethics and deontology is essential for the future of the profession.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must write a reference book on dental ethics. What is the central message?
options: Ethics is an art that combines values, responsibility, and humanity
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethics is an art that combines values, responsibility, and humanity.' Dr. Manal: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should she leave?
options: Ethics is in full evolution, full of opportunities
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Ethics is in full evolution, and opportunities are numerous for those who commit themselves.' Dr. Mourad: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must create a mentoring program in ethics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental ethical values.' Dr. Manal: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must manage the succession of her ethical practice. What is the best strategy?
options: Gradually prepare the transmission of values
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Gradual preparation of the transmission of values is the key to a successful succession.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must create an ethical charter for dental practices. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Patient trust is the pillar of all professional ethics.' Dr. Manal: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must train future mentors in ethics. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of ethical values
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of ethical values.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must prepare a testimony on his ethical journey. What is the most striking element?
options: Human encounters that shaped his values
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Human encounters are the most striking moments of a professional life.' Dr. Manal: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must create an alumni association in ethics. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the link and promote ethical mutual support
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Mutual support and the link are the drivers of an alumni association in ethics.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must write an article on the future of dental ethics. What trend should be highlighted?
options: Ethical innovation in the service of the patient
The decline in the need for ethics
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethical innovation must serve the patient.' Dr. Manal: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must create an ethical quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
options: Ethics, transparency, and respect for the code
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Ethics, transparency, and respect for the code are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Mourad: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should he leave?
options: The profession needs passionate and ethical visionaries
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'The profession needs passionate and ethical visionaries.' Dr. Manal: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must create an award for ethical young dentists. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Ethical excellence is the engine of the profession's evolution.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must write his memoirs. What common thread should be highlighted?
options: Ethical passion and encounters with patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethical passion and encounters with patients are the common thread of a professional life.' Dr. Manal: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must create a training center in ethics. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Training must train ethical and responsible professionals.' Dr. Mourad: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful inheritance?
options: Ethical values and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Ethical values and example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave.' Dr. Manal: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must write a letter to future dentists about ethics. What message should she convey?
options: Ethics is a fascinating discipline with a promising future
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Ethics is a fascinating discipline with a promising future.' Dr. Mourad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must create a scholarship for students in ethics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Supporting deserving students is an investment in the future of ethics.' Dr. Manal: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal must give a closing speech. What note should she leave?
options: Ethics continues to evolve with those who carry it
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Ethics continues to evolve thanks to those who carry it.' Dr. Mourad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad must transfer his ethical practice. What is the priority?

options: Promote mutual support and sharing of ethical experiences

options: Ethics is a magnificent human adventure

questions.question: Dr. Manal must leave a message to future generations. What is the message?
options: Ethics is a discipline worth living

questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad concludes: 'Ethics needs passion and dedication to continue evolving.' Dr. Manal: 'I am proud of you.'
